title: A finite module free modulo a nonzerodivisor of the maximal ideal is free
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] (a Noetherian commutative ring with exactly one maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$), let $x\in\mathfrak m$ and let $M$ be a finite $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] such that $x$ is a nonzerodivisor on $M$ (multiplication by $x$ on $M$ is injective) and $M/xM$ is a free $R/xR$-module [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Then $M$ is a free $R$-module.
